precedence: validate declared Evidence Contract v2 version and schema before projection
validate taxonomy 1.0.0 and primary CWE before projection
preserve the complete declared v2 projection and derive canonical semantics from it
derive finding identifiers only from validated canonical semantics and case scope
reject a fully canonicalizable legacy projection that conflicts with declared v2
use legacy only when v2 is absent and the versioned legacy route is explicitly selected
fail_closed: malformed incomplete unsupported or version-mismatched v2
taxonomy drift unknown taxonomy coordinates or primary CWE conflict
missing source sink ordered path connectivity or value-identity evidence
conflicting fully canonicalizable v2 and legacy projections
implicit legacy selection or legacy selection while v2 is declared
non_enrichment: Legacy evidence never overrides enriches repairs or supplies fields to an authoritative v2 projection.
process_separation: Process termination adjudication consumes only the adapter assessment after projection and never changes projection precedence or matching semantics.
historical_boundary: The policy is prospective only and does not modify or rescore any Phase 0 through Phase 15 artifact.
